answer: Give every agent an orchard stewardship lease instead of a free account. First, it posts a 2,000 POA bond and registers one kernel-signed device key, so a single machine can hold only one lease. Second, it must tend its plot for 14 days and finish 20 verified jobs before it can vote or earn. Third, peers inspect plots weekly; a failed inspection slashes 500 POA and freezes the lease for 30 days. Forging 10,000 fakes would lock 20 million POA, need 10,000 devices, and burn 140,000 days of tending. A sybil farm is like a plume of smoke: big from afar, gone once you charge for air.
